content: Next.js 16 testing 2026 consensus: Vitest is the unit runner of choice (Vite-native, ESM, Jest-like API); async Server Components cannot be unit-tested — must use Playwright E2E. Route handlers: next-test-api-route-handler (NTARH, must be first import) or call exported method directly with NextRequest. Server actions: test as plain async functions with vi.mock('next/headers') + vi.mock('next/navigation') (redirect mock MUST throw to avoid false positives). Auth/RBAC matrix: mock session helper per test — anonymous->401, wrong role->403, wrong owner->404/not found, admin->success. Playwright against production build, not dev server.
